hit_stop_note: The client pauses both fighters' animation; the server freezes only the target's AI for those ticks, so it is safe on an integrated server and over a network

cues: a red flash on unblockables (Story and Shinobi)
a sound sting per telegraph class

targets.input_latency: the first frame of a strike plays on the client the tick the key is pressed (client-predicted), the server confirms
targets.fps: 60 fps with 12 fighters and 20 projectiles on a mid-range PC
targets.network: playable at 100 ms ping: server-side sweeps with 2 ticks of lag compensation

lock_on.soft_lock: attacks curve 15 degrees toward the target in front
